references.text: The original instruction for the robe's neck opening, which was to be like the opening of a coat of mail with a woven border around it so that it would not tear.
The description of the blue woolen robe itself to which the neck opening belongs.
The high priest was not to tear his garments, illustrating the significance of the robe not being torn.
Job mentions the robe's neck opening as a metaphor for how sickness surrounds him.
